environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a private subnet with VPC endpoints for SQS. The task role has broad network access. No egress filtering is applied. The container runs with default networking allowing connections to the EC2 metadata service (169.254.169.254) and other internal services. SQS queue has no message attribute filtering or content validation policies. IAM task role includes sts:AssumeRole permissions for cross-account access.

config.metadata_service: IMDSv1 enabled on linked EC2 instances
